map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Franklin and Morrow publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-11-10 04:01): mail returned 15,398 (state 15,283); early in person 43,073 (state 43,072); ballots sent 16,916 (state 16,909). Clermont (as of 2026-11-10 14:42): early in person 19,198 (state 19,069). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-11-07 12:44): early in person 54,042 (state 53,903). Franklin (as of 2026-11-10 00:12): mail returned 75,813 (state 73,855); ballots sent 82,904 (state 82,879). Morrow (as of 2026-11-09 16:02): mail returned 1,418 (state 1,417); early in person 3,669 (state 3,667).
